name: Mira Solvang
bio: Solvang holds a gun steady at a dead run, which is the one thing gunnery ratings never capture. She charges accordingly.

personality.label: Cool professional
personality.description: Treats danger as skilled work. Delivers a dry invoice joke when everyone else is shouting.

move: A moving target costs more. Off we go.
Repositioning. This is included in the fee.
attack: Steady hand, moving feet. Taking the shot.
guard: Position held. I bill for waiting, too.
hold_fire: Holding fire. Ammunition saved, fee unchanged.
heavy_fire: This is becoming overtime. I need some cover.
Sustained fire on my position. Let us keep the repair bill sensible.
